post.summary: Sign electricity contract with BankID V2
post.description:
This method initiates a BankID signing request for an electricity contract associated with the provided contractUuid.
The contractUuid should be stored previously using SubmitContract (POST api/v2/electricity).
Sample request:
            
    POST /api/session/bankid
    {
        "contractUuid": "string"
    }

This endpoint checks the status of a BankId signing request by using the supplied reference. 
If the associated contract is successfully signed, confirmation emails are dispatched to both the customer. 
If the signing is unsuccessful, it logs the errors accordingly and returns a bad request to the caller with a descriptive error message.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: A unique identifier for the signing request.

200.description: Indicates the signing request was successful, and returns the signed data.

400.description: Indicates there was an issue with the signing request, such as a missing BankId reference, failure to generate a BankId response, or inability to retrieve the contract. A descriptive error message is included in the response.
